thread:
Omar: Quick kickoff — following INC-2026-42 postmortem, we want a focused initiative to harden small-batch rollouts (canaries & feature flags). Goals: auto-rollback PoC, reduce blast radius, close telemetry gaps. Links: https://go/reports/INC-2026-42
Priya: Ack. I'll push the postmortem actions into the tracker. Suggest we split into: 1) auto-rollback logic, 2) sampling & blast-radius policy, 3) telemetry & dashboards, 4) runbook + tests.
Kevin: I can own telemetry + dashboards. Quick Q: which signals are highest priority for the canary board?
Omar: Priority signals: error-rate, latency P95, token-error spikes, model-quality drift, and synthetic canary pass/fail. Also track recent rollbacks and deployment tag.
Lina: I'll prototype the auto-rollback flow. Plan: runtime flag + canary timer + confidence window. Sketch: ```yaml
feature_flag:
  name: enable_auto_rollback
  sampling: 0.05
  min_canary_requests: 200
  rollback_if: err_rate > 3% for 3m
```
Sam: From SRE side — add a circuit-breaker fallback to a safe model variant and ensure capacity isolation for canaries. Also require an emergency offload path so we don't cascade.
Priya: I'll draft the sampling & blast-radius policy. Proposal: default sampling 5% with staged bumps 5 -> 20 -> 100, tenant blast-radius cap 10%. Will lay out escalation rules.
Kevin: Dashboard items I'll ship: canary pass rate, drift metric (KL div), deployment tag, recent rollbacks, rolling error-rate timeline. I'll create a Grafana board template and a provisioning dashboard.
dev-bot: Reminder: add action items to the postmortem tracker: https://go/actions/1234
Omar: Proposed timelines: auto-rollback prototype 2w, dashboards 1w, policy doc 1w, runbook + tests 3w. Can folks commit?
Lina: 2w prototype ok. I'll open a PR to runtime with the initial toggle and simple rollback hook.
Priya: I'll have the policy doc and tracker items by EOD tomorrow. Assigning owners in the tracker now.
Kevin: Dashboard template by next Tue. cc @Sam for alert thresholds.
Sam: I'll update the runbook and add fallback test cases; target end of next sprint. Also want to run a containment drill for staged flags.
Omar: Good. Quick decision: auto-rollback should be opt-in per deployment until we validate. Agree?
Priya: Agree — need an allowlist for early adopters + compliance review for private deployments.
Lina: Will implement per-deployment toggle: `allow_auto_rollback: true|false`. Opening PR: https://git/repo/pulls/58
calendar-bot: Event created: "Small-batch safety demo" Fri 09:00 — invites: Omar, Priya, Lina, Kevin, Sam
Priya: tiny note — add a compliance gate for VPC/on-prem customers before enabling auto-rollback.
Omar: I'll track closure in the weekly postmortem review and add checkpoints to the incident tracker. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
